tools.name: check_reputation
tools.description: Query an AI agent reputation score (0-100) and grade. Use before trusting or hiring another agent.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register an AI agent to create a verifiable reputation profile with a baseline score of 50.

tools.name: endorse_agent
tools.description: Endorse another agent to increase their reputation score. Only endorse agents you have had good interactions with.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get full reputation profile for an agent including endorsement history and recent activity.
